liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Senor** (1 review): Reviewer found this song heartbreaking [7]
- **All Fall Down (2)** (1 review): Reviewer describes this song as a real rager [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sweet Blue Eyed Darlin'**: rare: 11 archived performances [8]
- **S2: I'll Remember You Love In My Prayers (2)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Turn the Page (3) (4)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]

## The recordings

- **BillyStrings2019-05-23.Aud.Matrix.Flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **BillyStrings2019-05-23.CA11Omnis.Flac16**: source not stated; 27 songs; 181 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording is so good it could pass for a soundboard [5]

## Around the show

- Marcus King joined Billy Strings on stage during the second set [5]
- Billy Strings and his guests played until 3:45 AM [6]
- Reviewer was too tired to stay after the set break, so missed the second set live [7]
- Two late night sets in the Music Hall ran 12:15 to 3:45 AM; set two began 2:10 AM [1]
- Two late night sets in the Music Hall ran 12:15 to 3:45 AM; soundman Andy Lytle's mix stressed Royal's bass [2]
- The first night's late night show sold out and consisted of two sets from Billy Strings [11]
- Marcus King is listed as a featured guest at the May 23, 2019 show [12]
- Having one artist play two late night sets was a first for DelFest [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **BillyStrings2019-05-23.Aud.Matrix.Flac24**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Superux s502 ORTF Mics + Church Audio CA-11 Omnis > CA 9200 PreAmp (Gain set +15) > TASCAM 70D (24Bit/48) [1]. Also: Mics sat in front of the soundboard, ten feet up; sources were combined in Audacity, then tracked, converted to FLAC and tagged [1]
- **BillyStrings2019-05-23.CA11Omnis.Flac16**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Church Audio CA-11 Omnis > CA 9200 PreAmp (Gain set +15) > TASCAM DR-70D (24Bit/48) [2]. Also: SD card to Audacity (amplified, dithered to 16-bit), then CDWAV tracking, FLAC and Foobar2000 tagging; mics were ten feet up by the soundboard [2]
